entries.summary: Implemented per-user GitHub video segmentation with per-course repos. YouTube-like video player with streaming proxy and preloading. Next segment preloads 10 seconds before current ends.
entries.details: New model: GitHubAccount (user, github_username, github_token). Removed repo_name field. API: GET/POST/DELETE /courses/github/ + GET /courses/{id}/github/. Video upload uses user's GitHub token with per-course repos. Default segment_duration=60 seconds. YouTube player: VideoPlayer.tsx with auto-play, single progress bar, chapters sidebar. Streaming proxy: views_video_stream.py fetches from GitHub and streams to user. Preloading: next segment starts fetching 10 seconds before current ends. Green 'Next ready' badge shows when preloaded.
entries.code:
POST /api/courses/github/ {github_username, github_token}
DELETE /api/courses/github/
GET /api/courses/{id}/github/ - returns repo_url, lessons, segments
POST /api/courses/video-upload/ {file, lesson_id, segment_duration}
GET /api/courses/stream/{segment_id}/ - streams video from GitHub

# Preloading: triggers at 10 seconds before segment ends
# Creates hidden video element to preload next segment
# 'Next ready' badge when preloaded
# Seamless transition to preloaded segment
decisions: Each course gets its own repo: aura-course-{course-slug}
Each lesson is a folder: lesson-{id}-{title}
User can override segment_duration via API (30-3600 seconds)
YouTube-like player with auto-play, progress bar, chapters sidebar
Streaming proxy fetches from GitHub on-demand, no local storage
Loading indicator shows when fetching from GitHub
Preload next segment 10 seconds before current ends
